title: Received a Pan Damaged Prior to Shipment
text:
Received a Pan Damaged Prior to Shipment. I was excited to try this 13”x9” baking pan as all of the ones I have are glass and often are more difficult to clean and maintain. A metal non-stick pan would be great! Unfortunately, the one I received was damaged. Worse, it is clear it was damaged even before it went into the packing box.

This is a nice, heavy pan that has a good non-stick finish on it. It doesn’t appear to be Teflon which is good. It should work well for things like casseroles, cakes and other recipes that call for this size baking dish.

Right out of the box, my pan was dented up. All four corners have been dented enough to be obvious in both sight and touch. The box in which it shipped was completely fine, though, which tells me that it went into the box already damaged before it was sealed and shipped. The damage was consistent with being dropped at an odd angle and under load, or having been inverted and having heave things stacked on top of it. I do not know if this occurred where it was manufactured or if instead it happened prior to retail shipment. Lack of scratch marks on the finish suggests the former.

I think I can pound it back into shape with a mallet and wooden dowel, but that’s not an acceptable solution. I should be clear, it does not impact usability, but it’s enough to impact the shape of some things baked in the pan.

I really wanted to like this pan but receiving an item that is damaged (and was likely damaged where it was manufactured) is a serious problem. I hope I am the only one who had this issue, but I cannot rate it higher based on a hope or an assumption. It’s a shame; it’s otherwise a nice baking pan.
